info.title: siner
info.description: Query the logs, traces, and metrics that siner keeps.

get.summary:
The attribute keys of the records of a signal and of their resources over
the retention, the most common first, with their types.

Suggests the fields, operators, values, and keywords that can go at the
cursor of a query, from the attributes and values of the retention.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The query as typed so far.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
The position of the cursor in the query, in characters. The end of the
query when missing.

get.summary: The attributes that have an index.

put.summary:
Indexes an attribute of the logs or of the spans in every day file, so a
query that compares it reads only the matching records. The writer builds
the index within seconds.

parameters.name: signal
parameters.description: `logs` or `spans`

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The attribute key, such as `user.id`

delete.summary: Drops the index of an attribute from every day file.

parameters.name: signal
parameters.description: `logs` or `spans`

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The attribute key, such as `user.id`

parameters.name: since
parameters.description:
The start of the range: a duration before now, such as `1h`, or an
RFC 3339 timestamp. One hour before `until` when missing.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: The end of the range, in the form of `since`. Now when missing.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most rows to return.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
The records to keep, such as `http.route = "/matches" OR user.id = 7`.
Every record when missing.

parameters.description:

parameters.name: until

get.summary:
The series of one metric, each in buckets of one step with the count, the
minimum, the average, the maximum, and the last value.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the metric

parameters.name: since
parameters.description:
The start of the range: a duration before now, such as `1h`, or an
RFC 3339 timestamp. One hour before `until` when missing.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: The end of the range, in the form of `since`. Now when missing.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most series to return.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
The series to keep, by their labels and resource, such as
`state = used`. Every series of the metric when missing.

parameters.name: step
parameters.description:
The length of a bucket, such as `1m`. One that makes 120 buckets at
most when missing.

get.summary:
The services that sent spans or logs in the range, the most requests
first. A request is a span that enters the service: a root span, or a
span of the server or the consumer kind. Each service has its requests and
its logs over the range and in buckets of one step.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description:
The start of the range: a duration before now, such as `1h`, or an
RFC 3339 timestamp. One hour before `until` when missing.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: The end of the range, in the form of `since`. Now when missing.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most services, or the most operations of one service, to return.

parameters.name: step
parameters.description:
The length of a bucket, such as `1m`. One that makes 60 buckets at
most for the list and 120 for one service when missing.

get.summary: One trace: its spans by start time, and the logs that carry its ID.

parameters.name: trace_id
parameters.description: The trace ID as 32 hex digits

parameters.name: since
parameters.description:
The start of the range: a duration before now, such as `1h`, or an
RFC 3339 timestamp. The whole retention when missing.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: The end of the range, in the form of `since`. Now when missing.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most spans, and the most logs, to return.

count.description:
How many records have the key. For resources and series, how many
resources and series.

indexed.description: Whether the key has an index.

type.description:
The JSON type of the values: `string`, `int`, `float`, `bool`,
`array`, `object`, or `mixed`.

AttributeKeys.description: The attribute keys of a signal, over the attached days.

record.description:
The attributes of the records: of the logs, the spans, or the labels
of the series.

resource.description: The attributes of the resources that sent them.

oneOf.description:
Its items are any JSON in the spec: TypeScript cannot name a union
that holds an array of itself.

AttributeValue.description:
The value of an attribute: the `AnyValue` of OpenTelemetry.

Bytes arrive as a base64 string, as OTLP/JSON writes them, so they read
back as a string. A double that JSON cannot hold, such as NaN, is a string
too.

Attributes.description: Attributes by key, in the order of their keys.

Bucket.description: The points of one series in one step.

oneOf.description:
The values a histogram recorded in the step: the counts of its
buckets and percentile estimates. `None` for a gauge or a sum, and for
the first step of a cumulative histogram, which only sets where the
counting starts.

last.description: The value of the newest point.

CompletionKind.description: What the text of a suggestion is.

Completions.description: What can go at the cursor of a query.

Distribution.description:
The values a histogram series recorded in one time step: its points
merged, with the increases of cumulative points.

bounds.description: The upper bounds of the buckets. The last bucket has no upper bound.

p50.description:
Estimates of the median and the 90th and 99th percentiles, by linear
interpolation inside a bucket. `None` without values.

ErrorBody.description: The body of every error response.

IndexList.description: The attributes that have an index.

samples.description: Up to three different bodies, newest first.

severity.description: The highest severity number in the group.

template.description:
The body with numbers, UUIDs, hex IDs, and quoted strings replaced by
placeholders.

LogGroups.description: Log lines grouped by message template, the largest group first.

partial.description:
The range has more lines than the grouping reads, so the groups count
only the newest ones.

scanned.description: How many lines the groups count.

truncated.description: More groups exist than the limit let through.

unindexed.description: The attributes the query compares that have no index.

level.description: The name of the severity: TRACE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, or FATAL.

resource.description: The attributes of the resource that sent the line.

source.description: `otlp`, or the service log source that read the line.

truncated.description: More lines match than the limit let through.

unindexed.description:
The attributes the query compares that have no index, so it read every
line in the range.

MetricList.description: The series in a range, by name.

truncated.description: More series exist than the limit let through.

MetricSeries.description: The series of one metric, each in buckets of one step.

truncated.description: More series match than the limit let through.

Operation.description: The requests of a service by the name of their span.

attributes.description:
The attributes of its newest request, which tell what the operation
is, such as `http.request.method` and `http.route`.

OperationDetail.description:
One operation of a service in a range: its requests over the range and
in buckets of one step.

attributes.description: The attributes of its newest request. Empty when the range has none.

buckets.description: Every step of the range, oldest first.

since.description: The range, after the retention capped it.

step_ns.description: The length of a bucket in nanoseconds.

Requests.description:
Spans that enter a service: roots, and spans of the server or the
consumer kind.

oneOf.description:
Estimates of the percentiles of their durations, off by 1% at most.
`None` without requests.

buckets.description: The buckets that have points, oldest first.

resource.description: The attributes of the resource that sends the series.

Service.description: One service in a range: its stats over time and by operation.

buckets.description: Every step of the range, oldest first.

operations.description: The requests by span name, the most first.

resource.description:
The attributes of the newest resource of the service. Empty when the
range has none of its telemetry.

since.description: The range, after the retention capped it.

step_ns.description: The length of a bucket in nanoseconds.

truncated.description: The service has more operations than the limit let through.

ServiceBucket.description: The requests and the logs of a service in one step.

ServiceStats.description: The requests and the logs of a service in a range.

error_logs.description: The logs of the error level and above.

buckets.description: Every step of the range, oldest first.

resource.description:
The attributes of the newest resource of the service that has any,
such as `telemetry.sdk.language`.

Services.description: The services that sent spans or logs in a range, the busiest first.

since.description: The range, after the retention capped it.

step_ns.description: The length of a bucket in nanoseconds.

truncated.description: More services sent telemetry than the limit let through.

Signal.description: The kind of record a query reads, as the API names it.

SpanEvent.description: Something that happened at one time in a span, such as an exception.

truncated.description: More spans match than the limit let through.

unindexed.description: The attributes the query compares that have no index.

since.description:
The start of the range, which chooses the day files: a duration before
now, such as `1h`, or an RFC 3339 timestamp. One hour before `until`
when missing.

sql.description:
One `SELECT`. It reads the views `resources`, `logs`, `spans`,
`series`, `points`, `attribute_keys`, and `attribute_values`, which
join the day files with a `day` column in front, or the tables of one
day as `"2026-09-28".logs`.

until.description: The end of the range, in the form of `since`. Now when missing.

rows.description: Each row has one value per column.

truncated.description: The query returned more rows than the limit let through.

SqlValue.description: A value of a SQLite column. A blob is its hex digits, as text.

detail.description:
The type of a field and how many records have it, or how many records
have a value.

text.description: The text to put in place of the characters from `start` to `end`.

Trace.description: One trace: its spans by start time, and the logs that carry its ID.

truncated.description: The trace has more spans or logs than the limit let through.

resource.description: The attributes of the resource that sent the span.

attributes.description: The attributes of the root span, such as `http.route`.

error.description: Whether a span of the trace failed.

kind.description: The OpenTelemetry span kind of the root span.

name.description: The name of the root span.

resource.description: The attributes of the resource that sent the root span.

time.description: The start of the root span.

Traces.description: Traces by their root span, newest first.

truncated.description: More traces match than the limit let through.

unindexed.description: The attributes the query compares that have no index.
